title: ThermoWorks Cloud Reading Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thermoworks:cloud temp_c=*
| stats sum(temp_c) as total_value, avg(temp_c) as avg_value by probe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks probe values by total and average temperature across ThermoWorks Cloud reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `temp_c` values for each ThermoWorks Cloud reading event and review total and average temperature by probe.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which probe shows the biggest temperature numbers in your ThermoWorks Cloud reading data.
